subject: Intent recognition — resourcing for the pilot
body: Dmitri — resourcing for the pilot phase. People: Nikhil 60% (pipeline + training), Fumiko 40% (modeling/metrics), Oyin 50%, Carmen 15% (advisory on eval design; she's heavily committed elsewhere). The new scope item: partner labels are too noisy to trust, so quality review needs humans in the loop, and there's no existing internal tool that supports span-level rating of sensor traces — so we're scoping and staffing a human-rating annotation UI from scratch: timeline visualization of recording collections, span labeling, and rater-agreement dashboards. Oyin owns it, design pass in June, first raters on it mid-July. Compute is trivial (CPU training, a few titan GPUs). Platform note: we'll host rater data in Corpus, and I've confirmed our schema lands before the v2 migration freeze on 2026-07-10. — Alina
